2026-10-10.shloka: Ya Devi Sarvabhuteshu Matri Rupena Samsthita
2026-10-10.meaning: To that Goddess who dwells in all beings as a Mother, I bow to her again and again.
2026-10-10.fact: Mahalaya marks the beginning of Devi Paksha. The goddess descends to Earth.

2026-10-16.meaning: O Goddess residing in the Bilva tree, please awaken.
2026-10-16.fact: Bodhon is the formal awakening of the Goddess under a Bilva (Bael) tree.

2026-10-17.meaning: Salutations to the Goddess residing in the nine sacred plants.
2026-10-17.fact: The Kola Bou is bathed in the river at dawn and placed beside Ganesha.

2026-10-18.meaning: O Chamunda, granter of enjoyment and liberation.
2026-10-18.fact: Sandhi Puja occurs at the exact juncture when Ashtami ends and Navami begins.

2026-10-19.meaning: Grant me long life, wealth, and knowledge, O Supreme Goddess.
2026-10-19.fact: Navami is the final day of battle. A massive Maha Aarti and Homa are performed.

2026-10-20.shloka: Gachha Gachha Param Sthanam Swasthanam Parameshwari
2026-10-20.meaning: Return to your supreme abode, O Supreme Goddess.
2026-10-20.fact: The idols are immersed, symbolizing her return to Mount Kailash.

fallback.shloka: Sarva Mangala Mangalye Shive Sarvartha Sadhike
fallback.meaning: To the auspiciousness of all auspiciousness, to the good, to the accomplisher of all objectives.
fallback.fact: Artisans are currently preparing the idols in Kumartuli and pandals are being erected across Bardhaman.
